name: analytes
title: Analyte master: CDISC test codes, specimens, units and default normal ranges
description: One row per laboratory test the dataset grades. Test codes and names are CDISC SDTM controlled terminology (codelists LBTESTCD C65047, LBTEST C67154, SPECTYPE C78734, UNIT C71620) except where CDISC_CT = N.

fields.name: LBTESTCD
fields.description: Test code used on records.csv and criteria.csv

fields.name: LBTEST
fields.description: CDISC test name (LBTEST submission value)

fields.name: LBSPEC
fields.description: Specimen type of the dataset records (CDISC SPECTYPE)

fields.name: LBSPEC_ALT
fields.description: Equivalent specimen graded identically

fields.name: LBDUR
fields.description: Collection duration (ISO 8601) when the test is a timed collection

fields.name: NCI_CODE
fields.description: NCI Thesaurus concept code of the LBTESTCD term

fields.name: CDISC_CT
fields.description: Y = LBTESTCD is a CDISC submission value; N = sponsor-defined code documented in NOTE

fields.name: ALIAS_LBTESTCD
fields.description: Space-separated CDISC test codes graded with the same criteria

fields.name: LOINC
fields.description: Optional LOINC cross-reference (one representative code)

fields.name: UNIT_SI
fields.description: Unit in which VAL_SI, the SI normal range and numeric criteria thresholds are expressed (CDISC UNIT submission value)

fields.name: UNIT_CONV
fields.description: Conventional unit of the VAL_CONV view (CDISC UNIT submission value)

fields.name: FACTOR_CONV_TO_SI
fields.description: Multiply a value in UNIT_CONV by this factor to obtain UNIT_SI (equals the units.csv row UNIT_CONV -> UNIT_SI)

fields.name: DECIMALS_SI
fields.description: Reporting precision in UNIT_SI; one reporting step = 10^-DECIMALS_SI

fields.name: LLN_SI
fields.description: Default lower limit of normal (UNIT_SI): ABIM Laboratory Test Reference Ranges, January 2026, converted to SI (MedlinePlus for INR, KDIGO G1 for GFR); 0 when only an upper limit is published; blank when the test has no LLN

fields.name: ULN_SI
fields.description: Default upper limit of normal (UNIT_SI): ABIM Laboratory Test Reference Ranges, January 2026, converted to SI (MedlinePlus for INR); blank when the test has no ULN

fields.name: DIRECTIONS
fields.description: Directions with a CTCAE term in at least one version; blank = no term

fields.name: TERM_V5_HIGH
fields.description: CTCAE v5.0 term for the HIGH direction

fields.name: TERM_V5_LOW
fields.description: CTCAE v5.0 term for the LOW direction

fields.name: TERM_V6_HIGH
fields.description: CTCAE v6.0 term for the HIGH direction

fields.name: TERM_V6_LOW
fields.description: CTCAE v6.0 term for the LOW direction

fields.name: NOTE
fields.description: Mapping and scope notes
